system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 14:16:09 UTC, an Explorer UserAssist registry value was updated for a path that decodes from ROT13 to C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe. This supports that PowerShell was run, but does not establish when it was launched or what it did.
Around the reported 13:40 UTC time, the proxy recorded ivy.chen's browser connecting to login.salesforce.com and requesting its login page and related resources.
At 13:26:57 UTC, the proxy recorded a short connection to desktop.dropbox.com with a DropboxUpdate user agent. This does not establish that files were shared or uploaded.
At 13:51 UTC, FILE-NWD-01 resolved WS-ICHEN-01 to 10.40.10.21 and attempted a TCP connection to that address on port 9997; the connection record shows no completed session.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied sensor coverage information reports that WS-ICHEN-01 winsec and Sysmon logs were not collected from 13:30 through 14:10 UTC due to a collection outage. This overlaps the reported PowerShell appearance, leaving a material gap in process and security-event evidence.
The available proxy and network records show connections and destinations, but do not provide the missing endpoint process command line, PowerShell script content, or user intent.
claims_not_established: Whether the PowerShell execution recorded in UserAssist occurred at approximately 13:40 or at another time.
What command or script ran, who initiated it, and whether its activity was malicious or authorized.
Whether the DropboxUpdate connection involved file-sharing activity or data transfer.
What process or purpose was behind FILE-NWD-01's connection attempt to WS-ICHEN-01 on TCP port 9997.
Whether the PowerShell activity was related to the scheduled svc-render password rotation or to workstation patching.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain alternate endpoint telemetry for WS-ICHEN-01 from 13:30–14:10 UTC, including EDR process and command-line records, Windows PowerShell Operational logs, and relevant security logs.
Review PowerShell history, script files, Prefetch, and surrounding UserAssist data to establish execution timing, command content, and parent process.
Check FILE-NWD-01 logs and network/security telemetry for the 13:51 UTC connection attempt to WS-ICHEN-01:9997, including the initiating process and intended service.
Verify whether Dropbox is installed or authorized on WS-ICHEN-01 and review available proxy or endpoint records for any associated file transfer.
Confirm with ivy.chen and IT whether PowerShell use occurred and whether any authorized support or maintenance activity explains it.
